comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Rib Extend Ends from a boss's top edge (mitcad#1857, GitHub #345), on the reported design (opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/rib-extend-rim-reported-test.cmake): two hollow bosses of different heights on a base, joined as one body (F2.b0), and a sketch (F6) through their axes whose line c30 runs from the higher boss's top outer edge down to the lower one's. The rib is the design's next feature, F8. As reported: a rib 10 thick on it, up to the next faces, its direction at right angles to the line, flipped towards the base, Extend Ends on. The start's continuation rises over the higher boss's top, and only the wall below the edge closes it off: before the fix the start stayed as drawn, leaving a wedge between the rib's tip and the curved wall, with the warning 'the start of the rib's curves meets no face of the bodies'. Now it fills up to the wall, without a warning, and the rib joins the body.
